## Analysis overview

Selects analysis-ready CIBIC-Plus records, calculates treatment-specific Week 24 summaries, and applies the efficacy model for the Week 24 comparison.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSCIBC`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: parameter code, restricted to CIBICVAL
- `AVAL`: CIBIC-Plus analysis score
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit number
- `EFFFL/ITTFL/ANL01FL`: population and analysis flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
